data.spec:
apps/speech/stt.py (own venv: apps/speech/.venv, Python 3.12, faster-whisper + sounddevice).
class SpeechToText(model:str='small', language:str|None=None, provider:'auto'|'elevenlabs'|'whisper'='auto')
  .listen(stop:'silence'|'enter'='silence', max_seconds=15) -> str   # records laptop mic, returns transcript ('' if nothing heard)
  .record(stop=...) -> np.ndarray float32 16kHz mono;  .transcribe(audio_array_or_file_path) -> str
provider auto = ElevenLabs Scribe if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (env or repo-root .env; model ELEVENLABS_STT_MODEL, default scribe_v1), else local Whisper; ElevenLabs errors fall back to Whisper. Keep language=None (auto): forcing 'no' translates English speech into Norwegian.
post_transcript(api, station, text) -> EventResponse: POSTs a canonical speech_transcript DeviceEvent to /api/device-events.
CLI: apps/speech/.venv/bin/python apps/speech/stt.py [--station kitchen] [--stop enter] [--provider whisper]
